<issue>
Text wrapping breaks return wrong newline character

#### Description

When working with Word documents that contain text wrapping breaks, the text extraction is returning incorrect newline characters. Text wrapping breaks should not produce newlines in the extracted text, but regular line breaks should.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.oxml.text.run import CT_Br

# Create a document with text wrapping break
doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.add_paragraph()
run = paragraph.add_run("Hello")

# Add a text wrapping break (should not produce newline in text)
br_element = CT_Br()
br_element.type = "textWrapping"
print(f"Text wrapping break text: '{br_element.text}'")  # Should be empty string
print(f"Expected: ''")

# Add a regular break (should produce newline in text)  
br_element2 = CT_Br()
br_element2.type = None  # or any non-textWrapping type
print(f"Regular break text: '{br_element2.text}'")  # Should be newline
print(f"Expected: '\\n'")
```

The text extraction from runs containing text wrapping breaks is producing newlines when it shouldn't, and regular breaks are not producing newlines when they should.
</issue>
